main_text.p: quæ contigit sub Juda Machabæo, & describitur 1.Machab.4.
Pahel Ch.& Syr. Indicare, renunciare, annuntiare, ostendere, monstrare, demonstrare. Aphel Idem. Ithpahel Nunciari, annunciari, indicari.
Ch. Indicatio, annunciatio, promulgatio. Cost. Indicatio ænigmatum, Dan.5.12.
Ch. Respondet Heb. תורה Confesio, celebratio, laus, Levit.7.2. in Targ. Hierosol.
Syr. Ostensio, demonstratio, exemplum, exemplar, instructio.

Ch.& Syr.Peccare, delinquere, Impiè, improbè agere, Reum, Debitorem esse vel fieri, Debere. Pahel Debitorem, Reum efficere, condemnare, Reum, sontem, improbum pronunciare. Ithpah. Debere, debitorem, reum esse, vel fieri, Condemnari.
Ch. & Syr. Peccator, debitor, reus, impius, improbus. Plur. Debitores. Fœmin. Improba.
Chal. Syr. Reatus, Culpa, noxa, debitum, peccatum, iniquitas: Dominus debiti, id est, Creditor, Lucæ 7.41. Plur.

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac words are printed in Hebrew and Syriac letters on the scan; they are rendered here only approximately where the type was not legible enough to copy exactly. Some Hebrew and Syriac forms are marked as uncertain and should be checked against the scan.
